title: 筛选高价值订单
description: 找出 amount 不低于 150 的已支付订单，并按 amount 从高到低排列。
challenge: 返回 order_id、customer_id、amount，不能包含 cancelled 订单。
hints: WHERE 中同时限制 status 与 amount。
使用 ORDER BY amount DESC。
starterSql:
SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount
FROM orders
WHERE
solution:
SELECT order_id, customer_id, amount
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid' AND amount >= 150
ORDER BY amount DESC;

explanationSteps.title: 过滤原始行
explanationSteps.goal: 保留已支付且金额达标的订单。
explanationSteps.detail: WHERE 在排序前工作，cancelled 订单即使金额很高也会被移除。

explanationSteps.title: 排序并输出字段
explanationSteps.goal: 让最高金额排在最前。
explanationSteps.detail: DESC 表示降序。

title: 最近活跃用户
description: 找出 2024-05-01 及之后至少登录过一次的用户。
challenge: 每位 user_id 只返回一次，并按 user_id 升序。
hints: 只保留 event_type = 'login'。
DISTINCT 可以去掉重复 user_id。
starterSql:
SELECT DISTINCT user_id
FROM user_events
WHERE
solution:
SELECT DISTINCT user_id
FROM user_events
WHERE event_type = 'login' AND event_date >= '2024-05-01'
ORDER BY user_id;

explanationSteps.goal: 定义“最近活跃”的业务口径。
explanationSteps.detail: 只有日期达标的 login 事件才算活跃。

explanationSteps.detail: DISTINCT 确保每位用户只出现一次。

title: 最新注册客户
description: 查询最近注册的 3 位客户。
challenge: 返回 customer_id、name、signup_date，注册日期相同时 customer_id 较小者优先。
hints: signup_date 使用 DESC。
第二排序字段使用 customer_id ASC。
starterSql:
SELECT customer_id, name, signup_date
FROM customers

solution:

FROM customers

title: 订单金额分层
description: 将订单按 amount 划分为 high、medium、low 三档。
challenge: amount >= 200 为 high，amount >= 100 为 medium，其余为 low。
hints: CASE 从上到下匹配。
先判断更高的阈值。
solution:
SELECT order_id, amount,
  CASE WHEN amount >= 200 THEN 'high'
       WHEN amount >= 100 THEN 'medium'
       ELSE 'low' END AS amount_band
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_id;

explanationSteps.title: 按顺序判断条件
explanationSteps.goal: 为每一行创建分类变量。
explanationSteps.detail: 260 先命中 >= 200，不再继续检查 medium。
explanationSteps.sql:
CASE WHEN amount >= 200 THEN 'high'
     WHEN amount >= 100 THEN 'medium'
     ELSE 'low' END

explanationSteps.title: 形成分析字段
explanationSteps.goal: 保留原始金额与新分类。
explanationSteps.detail: amount_band 可继续用于 GROUP BY。

title: 城市平均订单金额
description: 计算每个城市的平均订单金额。
challenge: 返回 city、order_count、avg_amount，平均值保留 1 位小数。
hints: 按 city 分组。
COUNT(*) 统计每组行数。
solution:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(amount), 1) AS avg_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY city;

explanationSteps.title: 按城市形成分组
explanationSteps.goal: 把相同 city 的订单放入同一组。
explanationSteps.detail: 此时结果粒度从订单变为城市。

explanationSteps.detail: 每个聚合函数都只看到当前城市组内的行。

title: 高客单价城市
description: 找出平均订单金额不低于 150 的城市。
challenge: 只能在分组完成后根据 AVG(amount) 过滤。
hints: WHERE 无法直接使用 AVG(amount)。
使用 HAVING AVG(amount) >= 150。
starterSql:
SELECT city, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
solution:
SELECT city, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY city
HAVING AVG(amount) >= 150
ORDER BY city;

explanationSteps.title: 先完成 GROUP BY
explanationSteps.goal: 得到每个城市的聚合结果。
explanationSteps.detail: HAVING 需要使用这个中间结果。

explanationSteps.title: 再过滤分组
explanationSteps.goal: 只保留平均值达标的城市。
explanationSteps.detail: 这是 HAVING 与 WHERE 的关键区别。

title: 总时长最长的专辑
description: 计算每张专辑的歌曲总时长，并返回总时长最长的专辑。
hints: 先按 album_id 聚合 SUM(length)。
ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 1。
starterSql:
SELECT a.album_id, a.album_name,
  
FROM albums a
JOIN songs s ON a.album_id = s.album_id
solution:
SELECT a.album_id, a.album_name, SUM(s.length) AS duration
FROM albums a
JOIN songs s ON a.album_id = s.album_id
GROUP BY a.album_id, a.album_name
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 1;

title: 部门最高薪员工
description: 找出每个部门工资最高的员工，并保留并列第一。
hints: 子查询按 department_id 求 MAX(salary)。
员工表同时连接部门表与最高薪中间表。
starterSql:
WITH department_max AS (
  SELECT department_id, MAX(salary) AS max_salary
  FROM Employees
  GROUP BY department_id
)
SELECT
solution:
WITH department_max AS (SELECT department_id, MAX(salary) AS max_salary FROM Employees GROUP BY department_id)
SELECT d.department_name, e.employee_name, e.salary
FROM Employees e
JOIN department_max m ON e.department_id = m.department_id AND e.salary = m.max_salary
JOIN Departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
ORDER BY d.department_name, e.employee_name;

explanationSteps.goal: 找出工资等于部门最高值的所有员工。
explanationSteps.detail: 同时连接 department_id 和 salary，因此保留并列第一。

title: 月度销售趋势
description: 按月份计算已支付订单的收入和订单数。
challenge: 返回 month、revenue、order_count。忽略 cancelled 订单。
hints: 先 WHERE status = 'paid'。
用 DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') 生成月份。
starterSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY
solution:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;

title: 客户消费排名
description: 计算每位客户总消费，并按总消费从高到低排名。
challenge: 并列金额使用相同名次，下一名跳号。
hints: CTE 中先按客户求 SUM(amount)。
外层使用 RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC)。
starterSql:
WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
solution:
WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT customer_id, total_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM customer_spend
ORDER BY spend_rank, customer_id;
